headline: Walmart and Eli Lilly Join Pushback Against Tokenized Stock Plans
summary: Five additional companies, including Walmart and Eli Lilly, have objected to tokenized stock plans, bringing total objectors to 38.
why: Corporate issuers frequently monitor and restrict unauthorized tokenized representations of their equities on digital asset venues to maintain compliance and control over shareholder records.

impacts.name: Walmart Inc.
impacts.why: Regulatory and issuer pushback limits unauthorized third-party tokenization of corporate equity.
